description: Execute the first migration wave for scenarios that still store durable runtime state outside api-core/storage or rely on ad hoc persistence patterns. Focus on high-risk scenarios first: the ones with important operator data, SQLite files, file-based stores, or deployment-critical state. Add or update STORAGE_AUDIT docs where the persistence layout materially matters.
name: high-risk-scenario-storage-migration-wave
title: Migrate high-risk scenarios onto canonical runtime storage
